name: Water & Wastewater
description: Potable water treatment and distribution systems, wastewater collection and treatment, stormwater management, and groundwater monitoring.

sub_industries.name: Potable Water — Treatment
sub_industries.description: Water treatment processes including filtration, chemical dosing, and disinfection to produce safe drinking water.

device_types.name: Pump Station
device_types.description: Raw or treated water pump station transferring water between treatment stages or into the distribution system.

tags.name: Flow Rate
tags.description: Water flow rate in gallons per minute.

tags.name: Discharge Pressure
tags.description: Pump discharge pressure. Indicates system head and pump performance.

tags.name: Motor Current
tags.description: Motor current draw for energy monitoring and fault detection.

tags.name: Run Status
tags.description: Pump operational status.

tags.name: Run Hours
tags.description: Cumulative pump run hours for maintenance scheduling.

device_types.name: Chlorination System
device_types.description: Chemical dosing system that adds chlorine to treated water for disinfection.

tags.name: Chlorine Residual
tags.description: Free chlorine residual in treated water. Regulatory minimum typically 0.2 mg/L at the entry point.

tags.name: pH
tags.description: Water pH. Chlorine effectiveness is highly pH-dependent; optimal range 6.5–7.5.

tags.name: Chemical Feed Rate
tags.description: Chlorine dosing rate in pounds per day.

tags.name: Chemical Tank Level
tags.description: Chemical solution tank level as a percentage.

device_types.name: Filter Bank
device_types.description: Multimedia or membrane filtration system removing suspended solids, turbidity, and pathogens from raw water.

tags.name: Differential Pressure
tags.description: Pressure drop across the filter media. Rising DP indicates filter loading requiring backwash.

tags.name: Effluent Turbidity
tags.description: Filtered water turbidity in NTU. Regulatory limit typically 0.3 NTU.

tags.name: Run Time
tags.description: Time since last backwash cycle.

tags.name: Backwash Status
tags.description: Filter currently in backwash cycle.

sub_industries.name: Potable Water — Storage
sub_industries.description: Finished water storage including ground-level tanks and elevated water towers providing system pressure and emergency reserves.

device_types.name: Water Storage Tank / Tower
device_types.description: Finished water storage tank or elevated tower. Level monitoring provides both inventory and system pressure data.

tags.name: Level
tags.description: Water level in the tank. Used to manage pump cycling and monitor storage capacity.

tags.name: Volume
tags.description: Calculated water volume in gallons.

tags.name: Water Temperature
tags.description: Water temperature. High temps accelerate chlorine decay; freeze risk in cold climates.

tags.name: Chlorine Residual
tags.description: Residual chlorine in stored water. Decreases over time; requires monitoring for continued disinfection.

sub_industries.name: Wastewater — Collection
sub_industries.description: Municipal wastewater collection system lift stations and force mains transporting sewage to treatment facilities.

device_types.name: Lift Station
device_types.description: Wet well and pump station that lifts wastewater from lower to higher elevation in the collection system. Critical to prevent sewage backup.

tags.name: Wet Well Level
tags.description: Wastewater level in the wet well. Controls pump on/off setpoints and triggers overflow alarms.

tags.name: Flow Rate
tags.description: Pump discharge flow rate.

tags.name: Motor Current
tags.description: Pump motor current. High amps indicate solids buildup or mechanical issues.

tags.name: Pump Run Status
tags.description: Pump operational status.

tags.name: Run Hours
tags.description: Cumulative pump run hours.

sub_industries.name: Wastewater — Treatment
sub_industries.description: Biological and chemical treatment processes that remove contaminants from municipal and industrial wastewater before discharge.

device_types.name: Aeration System
device_types.description: Blower-driven aeration system supplying oxygen to the activated sludge process for biological treatment.

tags.name: Dissolved Oxygen
tags.description: DO level in the aeration basin. Typical target 1.5–2.5 mg/L for biological activity.

tags.name: Airflow
tags.description: Air delivery rate in standard cubic feet per minute.

tags.name: Blower Power
tags.description: Blower motor power consumption. Used for energy efficiency calculations.

tags.name: MLSS
tags.description: Mixed liquor suspended solids concentration. Indicates active biomass in the process.
